theme_strategy: Light Theme primarily for public marketing pages (conveys cleanliness, daylight, purity). Dark Theme ('Utilitarian Obsidian') strictly for the Admin Panel.

color_system.description: Archetype: Swiss High-Contrast. No purple gradients. No muddy greys. Pure precision. High contrast between pristine whites and precision deep blues.

typography.rules: Never center headings. Use radical weight contrast (e.g., Light for main titles, Medium for small overlines). Manifesto chapters must use the 'labels' scale (e.g., '01 — LEISTUNGEN').

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x standard). Left-aligned/asymmetric editorial layouts. Never use centered generic card grids.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The Tetris Grid protocol. 12-column base. Leave empty columns to create tension and negative space.

motion_specs.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal. `initial={{ y: '100%' }}` wrapping lines in `overflow-hidden` spans. Stagger 0.15s.
motion_specs.scroll_animations: Purposeful, weighted motion. Elements should translate slightly upwards (`y: 40`) and fade in (`opacity: 0`) as they enter the viewport. Duration: 0.8s, Easing: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion_specs.micro_interactions: Buttons: scale down slightly on click (`scale: 0.98`), hover states introduce a 1px border or subtle background shift.
motion_specs.marquee: Slow editorial drift. Font: 'Outfit' Light, uppercase. Use `react-fast-marquee`.

component_styles.buttons: Sharp rectangular for 'architectural' feel. High contrast. No drop shadows. Use 1px borders. `hover:bg-foreground hover:text-background` transition.
component_styles.cards: Cardless design or flat rectangular with 1px subtle border (`border-border`). No soft drop shadows. Inner padding must be generous (`p-8` or `p-12`).
component_styles.inputs: Shadcn defaults but remove border-radius (`rounded-none`). Bottom border only for a highly editorial look, or very crisp 1px full border.
component_styles.navigation: Sticky header with Crystal Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70`). 1px bottom border (`border-black/5`). Desktop links must be visible, no hamburger on desktop.
component_styles.footer: Massive space. `py-32`. Asymmetric link alignment. Giant text for the brand name or CTA at the bottom (`text-[10vw]`).

brand_identity.logo_concept: Wordmark only. Font: 'Outfit' in Black weight, tightly tracked. Integrated with a sharp, 45-degree diagonal slash replacing the crossbar of the 'A' or placed beside the text, symbolizing a squeegee swipe or a beam of light. Minimalist, serious, monochromatic.
brand_identity.voice: Authoritative, pristine, precise. German language UI.

home.hero: Large kinetic text: 'Professionelle Gebäudereinigung in Achern & Umgebung'. CTA buttons: 'Kostenloses Angebot anfordern', 'Kontakt aufnehmen'. Spotlight image on the right, overlapping the grid.
home.marquee: Full-width slow scrolling text: 'SAUBERKEIT — QUALITÄT — ZUVERLÄSSIGKEIT — VERTRAUEN — PROFESSIONALITÄT'.
home.intro: Chapter '01 — VORSTELLUNG'. Asymmetric text block explaining the philosophy.
home.services_overview: Chapter '02 — LEISTUNGEN'. A staggered vertical list of services. On hover, a clipped image appears via framer-motion. Not a grid of standard cards.
home.why_us: Chapter '03 — WARUM CLEANORA'. High-contrast dark section for maximum impact. 'Qualitätsversprechen'.
home.process: Chapter '04 — ABLAUF'. Numbered steps laid out horizontally or in a cascading vertical timeline.
home.trust: Chapter '05 — VERTRAUEN'. Client logos or typography-based testimonials.
home.contact_cta: Massive footer CTA. 'Bereit für makellose Sauberkeit?'

page_blueprints.services_overview: Grid of services with generous spacing. Each linking to a detailed subpage.
page_blueprints.service_subpages: Editorial layout: Large header with the service name, a high-quality spotlight image, detailed description, what's included list, and a direct CTA to request a quote.
page_blueprints.about: The company's story, values, and team. Focus on reliability and precision.
page_blueprints.service_area: A map or stylized list of locations around 'Achern & Umgebung'.
page_blueprints.contact: Editorial split-screen layout. Left: Contact info (Placeholders: +49 (0) ... / Musterstraße). Right: Premium inquiry form with validation.
page_blueprints.admin_panel: Route `/admin`. Utilitarian dark mode. Login screen, and a simple dashboard to edit email configuration settings. Crisp, functional, dense.

imagery_direction.style: Real photography treated deliberately. Spotlight lighting, clipped frames, editorial cropping. Images should feel like architectural digests rather than standard stock.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Use left-aligned/asymmetric layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Utilize Tailwind `gap-16`, `py-24`, `mb-32`, etc.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT drop shadows.
Implement the 'Lenis' smooth scrolling library in the main layout.
Implement the masked line-by-line text reveal on the Home Hero using Framer Motion.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.
Use Shadcn components for forms, but override their default styling (e.g., remove borders/radii to match the strict architectural style).
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratios. The UI is in German.
For the 10 service subpages, build a dynamic route or a reusable template component.
The admin panel must be a separate route, styled in dark mode.
Ensure the FastAPI backend exposes endpoints for the contact form submission and admin email configuration.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for all Framer Motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` (kebab-case, role-based).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Always use modern button styles (sharp architectural buttons as specified).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`
